marc:datafield.marc:subfield: நிறைவான வாழ்க்கைக்கான நிகரற்றக் கொள்கைகள் | Niraivana Valkkaikkana Nikararrak Kolkaikal

Stephen R. Covey, renowned author of "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People," deeply believed in the potential for greatness within every individual. In this collection of heartfelt stories originally published in *Reader's Digest*, Covey provides a profound introduction and thoughtful insights at the beginning and end of each chapter. Readers will benefit from this book in three ways: first, as a refuge and source of hope in life's storms; second, as a source of inspiration to live up to one's potential; and third, as a reminder of the possibility of making a significant impact on the world. Through wise choices and principles, readers can shape their lives, achieve their goals, and contribute meaningfully to society.
